scope.context: User requested a post-development Codex Security standard scan focused on Tauri trust boundaries, local files, subprocesses, SQLite, audio parsing, and frontend-to-Rust commands.
limitations: Third-party dependency vulnerability databases were not queried because this was an offline source scan.
Generated schemas, compiled targets, bundled app copies, dependency trees, and binary image assets were excluded from manual source review.
scope.runtimeStatus: Static source validation plus the project's previously completed typecheck, lint, unit, browser, Rust, and native-window verification. No hostile media file was executed during the security scan.
scope.summary: Standard static security review of the ChordLens product source across the React/TypeScript renderer, Tauri/Rust backend, SQLite integration, audio import and browser analysis, Python Basic Pitch adapter, capabilities, and packaging configuration.
scope.validationMode: Independent baseline audit and two focused investigations, followed by parent-led source validation and attack-path calibration.

assets: User-selected local audio and file metadata
assumptions: The application runs as the current desktop user without elevated privileges
Audio import is user initiated through the native or browser file picker
The production window loads bundled local content only
Optional Basic Pitch and librosa installations are local dependencies outside this source review
attackerCapabilities: Supply a crafted, oversized, highly compressed, very long, or malformed local audio file and persuade the user to import it
Influence audio container bytes, decoded duration, and generated event density
Cause ordinary workspace navigation while recording is active
No remote code execution, remote content source, or pre-existing renderer compromise is assumed
securityObjectives: Bound memory, CPU, subprocess runtime, output size, and concurrency for untrusted media
Stop microphone capture whenever recording ends, errors, or the owning view unmounts
Release renderer audio resources on failure and replacement
Keep SQL grammar, filesystem scope, and process execution independent of untrusted strings
Prevent untrusted strings from reaching executable HTML or script contexts
threatModel.summary: ChordLens is a single-user, local-first macOS desktop application. Its principal untrusted input is user-selected or recorded audio. Security-sensitive boundaries are the renderer-to-Tauri IPC bridge, file-dialog-to-decoder flow, Rust-to-Python subprocess boundary, microphone permission lifecycle, and local SQLite persistence. No network service, remote navigation source, tenant boundary, or demonstrated renderer script-injection sink exists in the reviewed snapshot.
trustBoundaries: User-supplied audio file into Tauri filesystem and browser media decoders
React renderer into Tauri custom command handlers
Rust backend into the Python Basic Pitch process and its native media libraries
Operating-system microphone permission into the mounted transcription UI lifecycle
Renderer state and song metadata into SQLite persistence
